LanguageData.RK_Gene_SmallBody.label: small body
LanguageData.RK_Gene_SmallBody.description: Small, compact body that dodges better but hits weaker and carries less.
LanguageData.RK_Gene_Nimble.label: nimble
LanguageData.RK_Gene_Nimble.description: Carriers of this gene have heightened sensory receptor sensitivity, allowing them to better detect nearby threats and evade close-range attacks more effectively.
LanguageData.RK_Gene_PoorEyesight.label: poor eyesight
LanguageData.RK_Gene_PoorEyesight.description: Carriers of this gene have difficulty with precision aiming, resulting in slower aim time and research speed.
LanguageData.RK_Gene_FragilePain.label: fragile pain threshold
LanguageData.RK_Gene_FragilePain.description: Carriers of this gene have a lower pain shock threshold and go down more easily from injuries.
LanguageData.RK_Gene_GoodGardening.label: good gardening
LanguageData.RK_Gene_GoodGardening.description: Carriers of this gene work more efficiently with plants.
LanguageData.RK_Skin_PureWhite.label: pure white skin
LanguageData.RK_Skin_PureWhite.description: Carriers of this gene have pure white skin characteristic of ratkin.
LanguageData.RK_Gene_LargeEars.label: large round ears
LanguageData.RK_Gene_LargeEars.description: Carriers of this gene have distinctively large, round ears that give them enhanced hearing and an unmistakably ratkin appearance.
LanguageData.RK_Gene_ThinTail.label: thin tail
LanguageData.RK_Gene_ThinTail.description: Carriers of this gene have a long, thin, hairless tail that helps with balance and is a signature feature of ratkin anatomy.
LanguageData.RK_Gene_CuteFace.label: cute face
LanguageData.RK_Gene_CuteFace.description: Carriers of this gene have an adorable facial structure with rounded features, button nose, and expressive eyes that make them appear endearing and approachable.
